question: The world's largest drainage basin is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amazon Basin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Amazon Basin** is the largest drainage basin in the world.
 
• It covers an area of approximately **7 million square kilometers**.
 
• The basin spans across multiple countries in South America, including **Brazil, Peru, Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Venezuela, and Guyana**.
 
• The Amazon River, which runs through the basin, is the **second longest river** in the world and carries the largest volume of water.
 
• The basin is known for its **rich biodiversity** and is home to the Amazon Rainforest, which is often referred to as the "lungs of the Earth."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Amazon Rainforest** produces approximately **20% of the world's oxygen**.
 
• The basin plays a crucial role in the global **water cycle** and climate regulation.
 
• It is home to an estimated **390 billion individual trees** and about **16,000 species of plants**.
 
• The Amazon Basin also supports a diverse range of wildlife, including **jaguars, pink river dolphins, and macaws**.
 
• Deforestation and climate change pose significant threats to the Amazon Basin, impacting its ecosystem and biodiversity.
 
• Efforts are being made globally to **conserve and protect** this vital region.
